newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coles Myer sees higher net profit.
newsitem.headline: Coles Myer sees higher net profit.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd chief operating officer Dennis Eck said on Tuesday he expected an improvement in the group's net profit in 1996/97.
"Business by business I expect improvement," Eck said in an interview with Reuters.
Eck had been asked if he saw an improvement in net profit during the current financial year.
"I have already told the board that I have come forward with a budget that I believe in and it does show improvement."
The company earlier on Tuesday said it achieved a net profit of A$280.4 million in the 1995/96 year ended July 28 compared with a profit of A$423.4 million.
The lower result was in line with analysts expectations.
Sales rose to A$18.18 billion from A$16.80 billion.
